sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently 1st with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their recent loss, Sandbach's seven wins from ten matches demonstrate strong form overall. They then face Cheadle Heath Nomads away on Saturday 10 October at 15:00, continuing their busy schedule as they look to consolidate their league position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, while third-place AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall—both fixtures that could influence the tight top of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently 4th, are at home to Wednesfield Community on Saturday, then face Brereton Social away in a midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town (5th) visit Crewe on Saturday, and will host Foley Meir the week prior. Barnton travel to face Allscott Heath on Saturday 10 October. New Mills play at home to Market Drayton Town on Saturday 3 October, then visit Telford Town on the 10th. Shawbury United, on a six-game losing streak, must improve when they host Barnton on Saturday before visiting Alsager Town on the 10th. Brereton Social, with just one win in their last six, play host to Widnes Town on Saturday 3 October before facing Wednesfield Community midweek and then visiting Allscott Heath on the 10th. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Sandbach on the 10th after hosting Telford Town this Saturday. Widnes Town, pointless with just two draws from seven games, visit Brereton Social on Saturday. Foley Meir host Bilston Town on Saturday. Eccleshall visit AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday. Market Drayton Town visit New Mills on Saturday before hosting Widnes Town on the 10th. Crewe host Allscott Heath on Saturday before visiting Bilston Town on the 10th.
